an1.39:1.1: “I don’t envision a single thing that—when untamed, unguarded, unprotected, unrestrained—leads to such great harm as the mind.
an1.39:1.2: The mind—when untamed, unguarded, unprotected, unrestrained—leads to great harm.”
an1.40:1.1: “I don’t envision a single thing that—when tamed, guarded, protected, restrained—leads to such great benefit as the mind.
an1.40:1.2: The mind—when tamed, guarded, protected, restrained—leads to great benefit.”
